sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.key_language: The links must properly use the special "tagged" link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement ("Special Links"). — Section 1; page states "Updated: October 15, 2025".
sources.used_for: Definition of Special Links; compliance-requirement framing; basis of the compliance gate.

sources.title: Associates Program Participation Requirements (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.key_language: Clause 5: "link each use of the Content solely to the related Product detail page or other relevant page of the Amazon Site"; Clause 6: prohibits promotional activity by email, SMS, or offline materials.
sources.used_for: Link-use restrictions; email/newsletter rule for reader capture design.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies incl. Commission Income Statement (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.key_language: "Qualifying Purchases … occur when: (a) a customer clicks through a Special Link on your Site to an Amazon Site…" — page states "Updated: April 14, 2026".
sources.used_for: Why destination + tracking must be confirmed per link before conversion measurement is trusted.

sources.title: Associates Help: Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
sources.key_language: "the Operating Agreement requires that the following statement clearly and conspicuously appears on your Site: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'" Link-level disclosure must be clear ("(paid link)", "#ad", "#CommissionsEarned") and conspicuous ("placed near any affiliate link … They shouldn't have to hunt for it").
sources.used_for: Disclosure strip copy and placement (above the fold, near links); footer statement; CTA '(paid link)' labels.

sources.title: Understanding ASIN numbers: Your guide to Amazon's product identification system (Sell on Amazon blog)
sources.key_language: "It's a unique 10-character alphanumeric code assigned to every product listed in the Amazon store." Also: "Look at the URL for a product detail page in the Amazon store. The ASIN appears after '/dp/'."
sources.used_for: Format check for intended vs observed ASINs; the /dp/ URL convention used by the dashboard link-builder.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.key_language: "if there's a connection between an endorser and the marketer that a significant minority of consumers wouldn't expect and it would affect how they evaluate the endorsement, that connection should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously."
sources.used_for: Endorsement-context review in the publishing gate (S24 line of the project brief).

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers (FTC)
sources.key_language: "Place it so it's hard to miss… The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself. Disclosures are likely to be missed if they appear only on an ABOUT ME or profile page, at the end of posts or videos…"
sources.used_for: Above-the-fold disclosure placement standard; no buried-only disclosures.

sources.key_language: Not fetched directly; the URL was captured from the verified FTC page S06, which cites it as "the latest version of the Endorsement Guides … revised in 2023".

sources.title: .amazon Top-Level Domain — IANA Root Database
sources.key_language: Manager: "Amazon Registry Services, Inc."; generic top-level domain; "Delegated since 2020-06-02"; registry website nic.amazon.
sources.used_for: Factual context that link.amazon is a second-level domain under the .amazon gTLD operated by Amazon Registry Services — recorded as context only, no compliance verdict (FLG-003).

sources.title: Verify your site ownership (Search Console Help)
sources.key_language: Verification methods include "HTML file upload" and "HTML tag" ("requires the ability to edit the HTML source code of your site's homepage").
sources.used_for: Search Console readiness page; HTML-tag placeholder in the site head.

sources.title: PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice (Amazon Associates Central / Creators API docs)
sources.key_language: "The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API."
sources.used_for: API-policy check in the publishing gate: any automated product-data integration must target the Creators API, not PA-API 5.

sources.title: Welcome to Creators API (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.key_language: Prerequisites: "Be enrolled in the Amazon Associates program for your target marketplace"; "Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API"; operations include GetItems — "Retrieve detailed information for specific products by ASIN".
sources.used_for: Discovery path for confirming ASINs, titles, and prices once thresholds are met (Q-03/Q-06).
